title: Click-Clack Cuttlefish
statement: Bathed in warm, amber-tinted water and drifting meadows of feathery moss, this pocket-sized cephalopod flashes shifting geometric daydreams across its skin while meticulously sorting smooth river pebbles and sunken sea-glass beads by color. Whenever an arrangement pleases it, it celebrates with a polite, rhythmic click-clack of its beak and a tiny salute of pearlescent bubbles.
